anwikiarticlereview-desc: New article submission and editorial qualification review workflow
anwikiarticlereview-title-hint: Enter the official name of the page you want to create. Do not use category names or slogans.
anwikiarticlereview-title-placeholder: Enter the page name to create
anwikiarticlereview-title-invalid: The page name is not valid.
anwikiarticlereview-title-namespace-not-: Submissions are not allowed in this namespace.
anwikiarticlereview-title-exists: A page with this name already exists. You cannot submit a review for an existing page.
anwikiarticlereview-title-under-review: A submission for this page name is already being processed. Please choose another page name.
anwikiarticlereview-submit-success: Your article has been submitted for review. You will be notified when a reviewer responds.
anwikiarticlereview-resubmit-success: Your article has been resubmitted for review.
anwikiarticlereview-approve-success: The submission has been approved and the page has been created.
anwikiarticlereview-reset-success: The submission status has been reset.
anwikiarticlereview-loginrequired: You must be logged in to submit an article for review.
anwikiarticlereview-already-approved: Your account is already in the approved editors group. You can create pages using the normal editor.
anwikiarticlereview-user-has-submission: You already have a qualification submission. Open "My article submission" to view or update it.
anwikiarticlereview-content-empty: The article body cannot be empty.
anwikiarticlereview-content-too-short: The article body is too short (minimum $1 bytes).
anwikiarticlereview-content-too-long: The article body is too long (maximum $1 bytes).
anwikiarticlereview-summary-too-long: The edit summary is too long (maximum $1 bytes).
anwikiarticlereview-submit-failed: The submission could not be saved. Please try again.
anwikiarticlereview-submission-not-yours: You can only modify your own submission.
anwikiarticlereview-cannot-resubmit: This submission cannot be resubmitted in its current status.
anwikiarticlereview-cannot-withdraw: Only pending submissions can be withdrawn.
anwikiarticlereview-resubmit-disabled: Resubmission is disabled on this wiki.
anwikiarticlereview-withdraw-disabled: Withdrawal is disabled on this wiki.
anwikiarticlereview-concurrent-modificat: This submission was modified by someone else. Please reload and try again.
anwikiarticlereview-not-pending: This submission is not awaiting review.
anwikiarticlereview-review-failed: The review action could not be completed.
anwikiarticlereview-no-content: This submission has no content revision.
anwikiarticlereview-publish-page-exists: A formal page with this title already exists. The submission was marked as conflict and was not overwritten.
anwikiarticlereview-publish-summary: Created via new article review approval
anwikiarticlereview-no-submission: You do not have a qualification submission yet.
anwikiarticlereview-notification-retry-q: Notification has been re-queued for sending.
anwikiarticlereview-confirm-approve: Approve this submission and create the formal page?
anwikiarticlereview-page-already-exists: Warning: a formal page with this title already exists.
anwikiarticlereview-missing-page-text: This article has not been created yet. You can edit this page and submit it for review.
anwikiarticlereview-email-body-header: This is an automated message from $1.
